title: Elizabeth B
text: It’s a very pleasant experience! Our chef was great and our group was fun! Great way to spend some time.
author: Elizabeth_B

title: A fun thing to do together!
text: My daughter (17) and I (53) had a fantastic morning with our amazing  chef Antonio. There were no other participants that day, so we had Antonio all to ourselves and were able to ask him a million questions, and he answered and explained everything that we wanted to know. He even gave us restaurant tips and tips to barcelona’s best markets. It was a great experience, from the visit to Boqueria market to the preparation of the various dishes to finally eating and enjoying it all. And this was such a lovely thing for us to do together. Will definitely try to make it all again when we get home!!
author: inakU5409NQ

title: Fantastic experience

title: Memorable Experience!
text: We had a fantastic experience cooking with our 10 and 14 year olds cooking with Juan. The food was delicious and we learned so much about cooking, about Barcelona, and about Spain. It was a true pleasure and a highlight of our trip. It was also a lot of food!!
author: abbyj1232026

title: Family Cooking Class
text: We loved our cooking class! We had a large family (16 people) of various ages and had a blast. The food was delicious and a great representative of typical Spanish cuisine. The kids (3 to 18 years old) all loved the experience and walked away with a love for cooking. We also loved our journey to the market!!!!
author: Catherine B

title: We love food ! And we loved the things we learned
text:
Absolutely — here is a polished 90-word version:

We absolutely loved this Barcelona cooking class. As people who love food and love to learn, it was the perfect experience for us. The class was warm, welcoming, and hands-on, with just the right balance of cooking, culture, and fun. We learned so much about the ingredients, techniques, and traditions behind the dishes, while also enjoying a relaxed and memorable evening. It felt personal, authentic, and delicious from start to finish. We would highly recommend this class to anyone visiting Barcelona.

title: Cooking with Juan

title: Amazing experience
text:
Such a nice experience! We started by going to the market where we got a tour and tips on good food to try and what to choose. Then when we got back we made an amazing strawberry gazpacho, paella, bread with tomato, omelet and a Spanish version of crème brûlée. We could take as much white/red wine as we wanted, and there was also a really hot alcohol free drink :)
We got lots of good tips for cooking in general and our chef was super nice and fun!
author: 374sabinea
